name: Surendra Panigrahi/ ସୁରେନ୍ଦ୍ର ପାଣିଗ୍ରାହୀ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Surendra Panigrahi writes Odia poetry and works in literary translation. Sahitya Akademi's Odia catalogue credits him with Maila Chadaratiye, a translation of Rajinder Singh Bedi's novel, and Dui Dhadira Majhire, translated from Rajesh Joshi's Hindi poetry. These publications place his work across both verse and fiction.

His poem ‘ଗାଆଁ’ turns the remembered village into a place carried within the body. A mother's labour, fields, riverbank flowers, seasonal celebrations and familiar voices return amid the dust and smoke of the city. The village is more than a distant setting: it becomes the measure of an intimacy the speaker fears losing in an urban crowd.
